jam ante desponsatam, Samariæ commorantem, 'uxo-

precibus Mariammes expugnatus, Ananelum à

page.notes: The chronological lines at the top of the page carry a fraction-like mark after "Herodis" (top line and the lines beginning §. 12 and §. 13): a numerator over a denominator, roughly "11/411", "4/7 1/12" and "4/6 1/3" as printed; not transcribed with certainty. The arc sign before "Antigono" and "Ananelum" is a printed reference sign, not text. The "Hero-" at the foot is a catchword.
